expectation: The fibroblast-lineage cells will use the amino acids to make collagen for supporting material.

reason: Extracellular fluid contains processing enzymes and is the natural destination for the secreted collagen precursors.
expectation: The fibroblasts will release collagen precursors for processing into supporting material outside the cells.

effect: The collagen precursors were secreted and assembled into extracellular matrix, completing the supporting-material goal.
reaction: The sequence makes it clear that tissue includes material made outside the cells.
reason: The separate muscle differentiation conditions are the stated route from the remaining stem-cell population to muscle precursors.
expectation: A subset of the stem-cell population will progress toward muscle-forming cells.

effect: The muscle branch now has committed cells expressing muscle-protein messages, but they remain individual cells.
reaction: The distinction between committed cells and a mature muscle fibre is clear.
reason: The muscle messages and available amino acids suggest the cells can produce muscle proteins, as the fibroblast branch produced collagen.
expectation: The muscle-lineage cells will use the amino acids to make muscle proteins.

effect: The muscle-lineage cells made muscle proteins and became myoblasts, completing the final goal without yet forming mature fibres.
reaction: The distinction between separate precursors and a fused muscle fibre is useful.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making extracellular matrix was most worthwhile: the planned sequence connects gene expression and protein production to secretion and assembly outside the cells, showing that tissue includes extracellular material.

leastWorthwhile.text: The muscle branch repeated the differentiation-then-protein-production pattern, although the parallel helped contrast the two cell types.

surprise.text: The muscle goal ended with separate myoblasts rather than a mature fibre; the picture makes that developmental limit explicit.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary: the goals and picture descriptions gave each combination a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would continue to see how these precursors and extracellular materials become organized into tissues; the two branches set up that question clearly.
